business.what: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd is a technology partner of choice for industry-leading organizations worldwide, providing IT services, digital and business transformation solutions. It generates revenue through comprehensive multi-year contracts spanning cloud, data, enterprise solutions, cyber security, and full-stack artificial intelligence services.

segments.name: AI Services
segments.detail: Annualised AI revenue of $2.3 billion based on latest quarterly revenue.

segments.name: New-age Services
segments.detail: Generated $11.5 billion in new-age services including Cloud, Data, Enterprise Solutions and Cyber Security.

strategy: Build an AI Operating System for industries to accelerate deployment of agentic AI solutions.
Construct India's first AI-focused data centre with high rack density.
Strengthen the Infrastructure to Intelligence offering through partnerships with hyperscalers, frontier AI firms, and industrial OEMs.
Establish secure, resilient, and sovereign AI infrastructure.

narrative.read: TCS demonstrated strong top-line momentum with revenue expanding to ₹73,188 crore in Q2 FY27, backed by annualized AI revenue scaling past $3.1 billion. However, profitability faces headwind from annual wage hikes and elevated SG&A expenses, causing net profit to fluctuate significantly (dipping to ₹10,720 crore in Dec 2025).

promises.promise: Build 1 GW of AI data centre capacity under the HyperVault business.
promises.delivered: The reported financial tables and subsequent earnings calls do not track capacity progress or completion dates.
promises.quote: significant progress in the HyperVault business to build 1 GW of capacity.

promises.promise: Implement annual salary increments for eligible associates effective April 1.
promises.delivered: Executed as planned; wage hikes hit Q1 FY27 results, driving operating profit down sequentially from ₹19,276 crore in Mar 2026 to ₹18,556 crore in Jun 2026.
promises.quote: Announced annual salary increments for eligible associates across all grades, effective April 1, with top performers getting double-digit increases.

narrative.credibility: Management provides minimal explicit forward quantitative guidance in transcripts, but delivered on announced operational commitments such as April salary hikes while steadily scaling reported AI revenue.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Continuous sequential revenue expansion driven by deal wins and AI adoption.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Reported sales increased steadily each quarter from ₹67,087 crore in Dec 2025 to ₹73,188 crore in Sep 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Wage hikes in Q1 FY27 created temporary margin friction.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating profit dropped from ₹19,276 crore in Mar 2026 to ₹18,556 crore in Jun 2026, while OPM % edged down from 27% to 26%.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Strong cash generation underpinning business strategy.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Cash from operations grew consistently year-on-year from ₹41,965 crore in FY23 to ₹52,094 crore in FY26.

bull: Consistent revenue growth across four quarters, rising from ₹67,087 crore in Dec 2025 to ₹73,188 crore in Sep 2026.
Rapid commercial scaling of AI services, with annualized revenue surging from $1.8 billion in Q3 FY26 to $3.1 billion (crossing 10% of revenue) in Q2 FY27.
Robust operational cash flows, expanding from ₹41,965 crore in FY23 to ₹52,094 crore in FY26.
bear: Quarterly net profit volatility, highlighted by a decline to ₹10,720 crore in Dec 2025 compared to ₹12,131 crore in Sep 2025.
Margin dilution following salary increments, as operating profit contracted from ₹19,276 crore in Mar 2026 to ₹18,556 crore in Jun 2026.
Persistent analyst concerns regarding elevated SG&A costs, subcontracting expenses, and external consultant fees.
askManagement: What specific factors drove the sharp decline in net profit to ₹10,720 crore in Dec 2025, and are SG&A expenses now normalized?
With annualized AI revenue reaching $3.1 billion, what quantifiable impact are AI productivity pass-throughs having on total contract values and renewal pricing?
What is the projected capex timeline and completion target for HyperVault's 1 GW data centre capacity build?
